title: Dataverse _meta.dv.metadata.yaml
description: Entry point of a Dataverse metadata-as-code model: publisher, target solution and base language.

version.description: Format version of the model files.

prefix.description: Publisher customization prefix — permanent, 2-8 lowercase alphanumeric characters.

scope.description: Optional schema-name prefix (default '{prefix}_') that scopes the '? unmanaged' report: only server components whose name starts with it are listed. Never enforced on model names.

solution.description: Unique name of the target unmanaged solution in the dev environment.

locale.description: Base language of Display Names and Descriptions (the environment's primary language).

languages.description: LCIDs the labels are translated into (base language included or not), e.g. [1033, 1036]. A missing translation is a warning.
